[U.S. import prices up 1.9% in May on higher fuel prices; export prices rise 1.3%](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/ximpim.nr0.htm "U.S. import prices up 1.9% in May on higher fuel prices; export prices rise 1.3%")

In May, U.S. import prices rose 1.9 percent following an increase of 2.0 percent in April.
U.S. export prices advanced 1.3 percent in May, after rising 3.5 percent in April. Over the
past 12 months, import prices increased 6.7 percent and export prices rose 11.2 percent.
